name: agentic-workspace
description: The workspace context kit's plugins: closeout, the end-of-session promotion ritual; projects, the life of a project from its start to its close; and workspace, the first-time setup and the upkeep that follows.

plugins.name: closeout
plugins.description: A safety net for the end-of-session documentation ritual: /closeout promotes learnings live and brings the project's Current state block and Done when list up to date, and if you forget, a SessionEnd hook captures the learnings into a draft the next session offers to promote.

plugins.name: projects
plugins.description: The life of a project, kept in its README: /projects:new interviews for the finish line, the people, how it is versioned and whether it is sensitive; /projects:adopt adds what an existing project is missing and changes how it is versioned; hold, board, pickup and close pause, show, resume and archive the work; /projects:pair runs a product-manager session and a Claude Code engineer through a mailbox. A session-start line says where the folder's project stands, and which of its resources this machine has not mapped.

plugins.name: workspace
plugins.description: Set up and look after a shared agentic workspace: /workspace:quick-start interviews the team and each person, makes the kit the team's own and checks it is reachable on every surface people use; /workspace:hygiene runs the weekly tidy of where context lives, submodules included; /workspace:register-audit checks guidance files for the register they are written in. A session-start line names what is out of step, and a guard keeps agents from bypassing the git hooks.
